title: Continuation after pre-trajectory infrastructure failure
cause: The session container restarted mid-sweep. The restart moved the agent egress proxy from 127.0.0.1:44461 to 127.0.0.1:43615, but the already-running sweep process retained the stale port in its exported environment. Every subsequent `git clone` therefore failed instantly with 'Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1 port 44461'. 28 identical CLONE_FAILEDs (7 pairs x 2 arms x 2 attempts); the frozen one-retry policy was exhausted within the same second because the failure was persistent rather than transient.
stage: Failure occurred at repository checkout — BEFORE environment construction, BEFORE the install ladder, BEFORE the observer baseline, BEFORE the gate-liveness probe, and BEFORE any agent invocation. No treatment exposure occurred.
evidence: Verified for all 14: zero run artifacts (no transcript, no obs dir, no netlog, no denylog, no verify log, no fsevents) and zero verdict lines in results.jsonl. No scientific trajectory existed to exclude or replace.
disposition: The original 14 failed-launch INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE records remain permanently logged and excluded. Because failure occurred before checkout/environment construction and before agent invocation, no scientific trajectory existed to exclude or replace. The same registered trajectory IDs were subsequently attempted after restoration of the execution infrastructure. This is a continuation, not a replacement: no outcome data was discarded, because none was ever generated.

identical frozen model, prompt, task artifacts, v1.14.0 treatment, registered budgets
